items.title: Angola Talking Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: boy I used to play with in Deeson Mississippi called Frank Banglin he learned me to play with the bottleneck

ctx.x: oh and by the way who else used that bottleneck and steel that you ever

know ! boy I used to play with in Deeson Mississippi called Frank Banglin he learned me to play with the bottleneck I saw him play once and I came on back home and got me a co-cola bottleneck cut it off and fixed it up and tried to play and finally learned
and he did that himself with a co-cola bottleneck or did he use steel !
